verdict.rationale: Composio documents triggers that capture events in connected apps (new Slack message, GitHub commit, incoming email) and POST them as signed structured payloads to a registered webhook. The evidence shows no built-in rule definition or automatic action execution, so the user must write their own webhook handler to run any action. missing for 10: a native rule/condition engine for defining event-to-action mappings, automatic action execution without custom webhook code, independent or hands-on corroboration of triggers.
